q: When a system is in static equilibrium, the resultant force on the system is _____
e: When a system is in static equilibrium, the resultant force on the system is zero. Do not trade zero for maximum or equal to weight.

q: When a system is in static equilibrium, the resultant torque on the system is _____
e: Torque is r × F, a cross product, so it is a vector. When a system is in static equilibrium, the resultant torque on the system is zero. Maximum or equal to angular momentum is not this quantity.

q: The principle of moments states that for a pivoted object to be in balance, the total clockwise moment must equal the total _____ moment.
e: Superposition: the resultant at a point is the sum of the individual displacements. The principle of moments states that for a pivoted object to be in balance, the total clockwise moment must equal the total anticlockwise moment. Downward or horizontal is not this quantity.

q: Applications of the principle of moments include all of the following EXCEPT _____
e: Superposition: the resultant at a point is the sum of the individual displacements. Applications of the principle of moments include all of the following EXCEPT free-falling object. Beam balance or building site crane is not this quantity.

q: In static equilibrium under parallel forces, the sum of upward forces equals the sum of _____ forces.
e: In static equilibrium under parallel forces, the sum of upward forces equals the sum of downward forces. Sideways or torque is not this quantity.

q: For a uniform metre rule balanced horizontally, its weight is considered to act at the _____ mark.
e: For a uniform metre rule balanced horizontally, its weight is considered to act at the 50 cm mark. Do not trade 50 cm for 0 cm or 100 cm.

q: The conditions of static equilibrium require both force balance and _____ balance.
e: The conditions of static equilibrium require both force balance and torque balance. Energy or velocity is not this quantity.

q: If an object is uniform and symmetric, its center of gravity lies at its _____
e: If an object is uniform and symmetric, its center of gravity lies at its geometrical center. Edge or fulcrum is not this quantity.

q: In analyzing equilibrium of extended bodies, we often take moments about the _____ to simplify calculations.
e: In analyzing equilibrium of extended bodies, we often take moments about the pivot to simplify calculations. Center of mass or top end is not this quantity.

q: The reaction force at a support in equilibrium problems is typically _____
e: The reaction force at a support in equilibrium problems is typically part of force balance. Do not trade part of force balance for ignored or equal to applied torque.
